note: A KILLED build leaves the incremental cache corrupt, and cargo clean -p CRATE does NOT fix it. Symptom: the linker fails with ld: symbol not found for architecture arm64, naming unresolved _anon.HASH.llvm.N symbols in a crate you never touched -- seen on hornvale-vessel lib test after a backgrounded git commit running gate-commit was stopped mid-build. cargo clean -p hornvale-vessel DID rebuild it, the rcgu hash changed, and it failed identically -- so staleness of that crate artifact is the wrong hypothesis. Building the same target with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 succeeded in 2m12s, which localises the fault to the incremental cache alone. FIX: rm -rf THE_WORKTREE/target/debug/incremental -- 6.8G here -- then rerun the gate normally. Cost before the right hypothesis: two failed gate-commit runs, 411s and 481s. Worth knowing because gate-commit is the likeliest thing to be killed, being long, and its failure then names an innocent crate.
